speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition better, could you tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms, and has the abdominal pain changed in intensity or location over time? I'd also like to know if you've noticed any swelling in other areas of your body.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any fevers or itching, and have you noticed any pain in your abdomen or back when drinking alcohol? I would also like to know if you have had any changes in your bowel habits or appetite.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of HIV or other risk factors for immunosuppression? REQUEST TEST: CT_Chest_Abdomen_Pelvis

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CT_Scan_Thorax_and_Abdomen: Findings: Massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Patient
text: I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: I have reviewed your history of B symptoms, fixed lymphadenopathy, and smoking history. I will now order a biopsy of the supraclavicular node to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Lymph_Node_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Cervical_Lymph_Node_Biopsy: Findings: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results showing CD20-positive lymphocytes with a high proliferative index confirm a B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
